page.layout: One printed page of text, with a centred table in the middle and a centred "Caput" heading at the foot. No marginal notes on this page. The page number and running head stand at the top. A faint vertical strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: autem subductio consectarium esse posse, è 5 d.6. Si enim rationum additio fit per multiplicationem, subtractionem per diuisionem fieri debere, consequens est. Siue igitur quotos inter se diuidas, siue datarum partium alternos terminos inuicem multiplices (alterna enim multiplicatio in partibus idem quod diuisio præstat) termini fiunt, reliquam inter se rationem seruantes.
Vt à dupla auferatur sesquialtera, relinquitur sesquitertia. Item, à dupla sesquialtera auferatur sesquiquarta, restat dupla. Exempla sic erunt:

¶ Rationum proprie nulla est Multiplicatio, qualis numerorum, nisi rationis continuationem pro multiplicatione sumere uelis. Sed & nulla earum Diuisio requirenda, præter inuentionem unius uel plurium mediorum proportionalium. Quare ad sequentia progrediendum.
main_text.head: CAPVT

page.notes: The table's column headings and the "uel" alternative in the Reliqua column are set as printed. The fractions in the last row are reconstructed from the scan (1 1/2, 1 1/3, 1 1/2, 1 1/4) and are only approximately right. The word "subductio" at the start of the continuation is partly obscured. The "CAPVT" heading has no number visible on this page. The faint ghosted text in the lower half of the page is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed.
